title: 용 세트 솔로 #086 · 가나·비취 용(눈동자 최대)·혀 연보라·독니 은 밴드+앞니 다이아 · P25 · 배경 창가 푸른 새벽 방 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_049`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the middle of her chest, her whole shoulders, collarbones and chest in view, the frame cutting off below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A striking adult Ghanaian woman — Ghanaian fresh natural beauty with deep, rich blue-black skin and real visible pores, early 20s, long sleek black waves swept behind both ears, a full makeup: a flawless satin base, sculpted contour, long voluminous lashes and a glossy nude-rose lip, real jade eastern dragon eyes: enormous glossy bright jade-green irises about twice the size of a natural iris, each iris filling the whole eye opening edge to edge from corner to corner and from upper lid to lower lid so that the eyes read as one large field of colour, with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, tiny darker jade diamond-shaped scale marks flanking the slit and a faint green glow around the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a dreamy, soft gaze — a photograph of a real Ghanaian woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a soft round face with full cheeks, a slender nose and a wide, expressive mouth. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a coiling eastern dragon in jade green and gold with black-edged scales, waves and clouds, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes and eyelids stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in jade green, emerald and soft gold, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-green that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Dragon horns: two slender dragon horns grow from the sides of her forehead at the hairline, one above each temple, each horn rising a short way and then sweeping smoothly backward along the side of her head, lying low and close to her skull like swept-back antlers and ending in a fine curved point above and behind her ear, each about as long as her hand, a carved jade-green horn, translucent and glossy like real jade, with fine ridges running along its length and a pale gold tip; the base of each horn grows out of her real skin with a small natural ring of skin around it, the two horns are the same, and they frame her face as two slim curved horns on either side of her head, above her forehead tattoo and beside her swept-back hair. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): extremely heavy-lidded, almost closed, smouldering eyes with a very deep-set heavy upper lid covering about half of the iris,extremely thick long curled lashes resting on the lid and a long sharp winged liner; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are a dragon's brow ridges: above each eye a raised ridge of small overlapping jade-green scales with gold edges and tiny pointed spines along its top follows the line of the brow and sweeps outward and upward at the outer end into one short, fine, curved spine, so that each brow reads as a scaled ridge in the shape of a natural brow, sitting on the brow bone below the forehead tattoo, with the real skin of her forehead and eyelids around it and the pores visible. Her cheeks: from each side of her nose grow two long, fine, gold-coloured dragon whiskers that sweep out across the cheeks and back toward her ears in graceful curves, the jawline and chin staying bare real skin. Her lips and mouth: her lips are a dragon's lips, a row of small, smooth, glossy jade-green scales with fine gold edges covering the whole of both the upper lip and the lower lip from one corner of her mouth to the other and following the outline of each lip, so that her upper lip and her lower lip both read as scaled jade lips, and from each corner of her mouth a fine gold line curls upward and outward across the cheek in a graceful flourish, about as long as a thumb, like a dragon's wide mouth line (this replaces any lip colour described above). Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, pale icy lilac, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen and a thin silver band around the base of each fang, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. The upper front teeth show too, each one set with a tiny round diamond at its centre, small white gems glinting in a neat row. Below her neck: everything from the base of her neck downward is a dragon's skin instead of human skin, so that her whole body below the neck is scaled like a real dragon's body: both shoulders, both collarbones, the hollow between them, the centre of her chest and the whole upper chest, from one shoulder to the other and from the neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of jade-green dragon scales, each scale rounded and edged with a fine gold line, glossy like carved jade and a little larger toward the shoulders, the scales running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on the shoulders, real scales with each scale clearly visible; the scaled skin begins at a clean line around the base of her neck, while her face and neck stay real human skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible; her long thin tongue stands out clearly against the scales.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventeen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the upper opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the lower opening holding one very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; two small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; two small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. The ornate earring and the weights hang side by side from the two openings without touching or hiding each other. All the ear weights hang from the bottom of the lower iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly five separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear rough-cast matte yellow gold a ship's anchor on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a round bell on a short chain, dark patinated bronze a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a long chain, dull pewter-grey tin a barrel-shaped weight on a longer chain; on the right ear dull blue-grey lead a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, oxidized dark copper a cube-shaped block on a short chain, dark patinated bronze a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a hammer head on a long chain, blackened cast iron a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain. On each ear the lower iron ring carries its own column of 5 weights on chains of different lengths, staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a quiet room beside a tall window, with soft pale blue pre-dawn light and a cool blurred grey-blue wall behind her, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
